name: Amreli–Lathi National Highway
significance: NH 351F is a branch of NH 351. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Amreli to Lathi, and it meets NH 351 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 351 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Mahuva to Jetpur
